<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/payment_methods"}
#docs
With no `limit`/`starting_after` the whole list is returned; with either, the reply is a page carrying `has_more` and `next_cursor` (a payment method id to pass as `starting_after`).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | no | Only these types (comma-separated), e.g. card,upi |
| `status` | `string` | no | Only these statuses (comma-separated), e.g. valid,expiring |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of payment methods to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | OUR id for the vaulted instrument. Not the gateway's — see reference_id. |
| `data.provider` | `string` | The payment provider that holds the card. |
| `data.type` | `string` | Instrument kind, e.g. card. |
| `data.brand` | `string` | The card brand, e.g. `visa`. |
| `data.last4` | `string` | The last four digits of the card number. |
| `data.exp_month` | `integer` | The card's expiry month (1-12). |
| `data.exp_year` | `integer` | The card's expiry year (four digits). |
| `data.status` | `string` | The payment method's status. |
| `data.role` | `string` | primary \| backup \| none. `none` = excluded from automatic collection. |
| `data.is_default` | `boolean` | Convenience for role === primary. |
| `data.gateway_account` | `string` | Gateway account that vaulted (and will charge) this method; null for legacy env-configured providers with no gateway_accounts row. |
| `data.gateway_account_label` | `string` | The label of the gateway account that holds this payment method. |
| `data.reference_id` | `string` | The GATEWAY's reference for the instrument, `<gateway customer id>/<gateway token id>`. Token-only for gateways with no customer object of their own (PayPal). Null when the gateway supplied no token — render nothing rather than substituting the pm_… id. |
| `data.instrument` | `object` | What the gateway knows about the instrument itself. Null when it reported none of it. A null FIELD inside means that one fact is unknown — in particular a null `issuer_country` is UNKNOWN, never 'not issued in India'. |
| `data.mandate` | `object` | The mandate this instrument was registered under, as the PROVIDER reports it. Null on a plain card-on-file with no mandate rail. A null `max_amount_minor` means the provider reported no ceiling — unknown, NOT unlimited. |
| `data.avs_check` | `object` | What the gateway said about the address / CVC when this instrument was vaulted or charged. Null means nothing was captured — distinct from `unchecked`, which is a real verdict a gateway can send. Stripe only today. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment method was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_methods?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "payment_method",
      "id": "pm_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
      "provider": "stripe",
      "brand": "visa",
      "last4": "4242"
    }
  ]
}
```
